decisions.title: A Slow Command Yields a Session, It Does Not Return Instantly
decisions.description: Codex unified_exec waits a yield window inside exec_command. Fast commands often finish in that same tool call. Only a still-running process returns session_id. Responsiveness is 'how long this tool call may wait', not a background flag on the old shell tool.
decisions.alternatives: A fire-and-forget run_background tool that returns an id immediately would be simpler to demo, but it is not how Codex talks to the model.

zh.title: 慢命令先 yield 再交 session，不是立刻返回 id
zh.description: Codex 的 unified_exec 在 exec_command 里先等一个 yield 窗口。快命令往往这一次就结束；只有还在跑的进程才返回 session_id。响应性是「这一次工具调用最多等多久」，不是给旧的 shell 加一个 background 标记。

decisions.title: EventMsg Is for the Client, Not Pushed into the Model
decisions.description: ExecCommandBegin and ExecCommandEnd ride the client event stream so the TUI can show live progress. They are not injected into the model context. The model sees another snapshot only when it calls write_stdin (or the user starts a new turn).
decisions.alternatives: Auto-injecting a completion notification on process exit would look more event-driven, but stock Codex does not do that — idle exit does not start a new inference turn.

zh.title: EventMsg 给客户端，不推给模型
zh.description: ExecCommandBegin / ExecCommandEnd 走客户端事件流，供 TUI 刷进度，不会灌进模型上下文。模型要再看一眼，只能再调 write_stdin（或用户新开一轮）。

decisions.title: Harvest Is write_stdin, Empty chars Means Poll
decisions.description: The session table keeps the live child and the output already shown. write_stdin with empty chars waits another yield window and returns the next snapshot or the exit. Non-empty chars in real Codex write to the PTY; this chapter only implements the poll path.
decisions.alternatives: A dedicated check_background(id) tool would match a teaching poll API, but Codex reuses write_stdin as both stdin and harvest.

zh.title: 收割走 write_stdin，空 chars 就是轮询
zh.description: 会话表里留着还在跑的子进程和已经给过模型的输出。空 chars 的 write_stdin 再等一个 yield 窗口，返回下一片输出或退出码。原版非空 chars 会写进 PTY；本章只实现轮询这条路。
